question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which story did you like the best?
Do you like April Fool's Day?

nodes.text: $ZOE is baby-sitting Howard's twin sisters on Easter Sunday. She's watching a TV show with them, when nature calls...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going to be in the bathroom for a sec, so no funny business, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever.
Kay changes the channel on the TV. Kel frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `mean` it. The last time I baby-sat, I was out of the room for `thirty seconds,` and you glued everything in my purse together!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] it. The last time I baby-sat, I was out of the room for [color=#3b78e2][i]thirty seconds,[/i][/color] and you glued everything in my purse together!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Haha. `$ZOE's Ball of Stuff.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha. [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE's Ball of Stuff.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: One of our better pranks. My idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Girls? Do I have your word?
The twins nod lethargically...
Twenty-nine seconds later, $ZOE throws open the bathroom door and rushes into the living room!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop whatever you're doing this instant!
But Kay and Kel are still sitting there, watching TV. $ZOE checks inside her purse.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No ball of stuff... No blazing kitchen fire... No rabid yak...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you girls feeling all right?
Kay knocks the remote control off the couch!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No, $ZOE! Not at all! We're way sad!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Way sad!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard's going away to college! He's leaving us!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Why? So he can get smart and be a stupid grown-up?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What's the point of pulling pranks if he's not around to suffer, er... I mean, appreciate them?!
$ZOE sits down between them on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know how you girls are feeling... I'm kind of in the same spot.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You prank him too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee! No... I meant, I'm also going to miss him. He's only been away for his interview for a day, and I can't stop thinking about his smile.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Gross.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be really hard for our relationship if he gets into Kingston University... It's all the way on the East Coast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully, it won't be that bad, and we'll get to see him almost as much as we do now...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Get the cupcake batter out of your eyes!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It's going to be awful! It's Easter, and he's off looking at some bush-league college with our parents!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you mean Ivy League... Kingston's an Ivy League school.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Whatever! Bush, ivy, they're all plants, and plants suck! The point is, he's not here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! This is just a taste of what it's going to be like, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Easter is officially ruined!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are the twins right? Is this just a taste of what it's going to be like with Howard gone?
$ZOE suppresses the thought and rises from the couch!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard might not be here right now, but that doesn't mean that Easter is ruined! We can still have fun without him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Up, girls, up! It's time for a good old fashioned Easter Egg Hunt!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Now,` please!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Now,[/i][/color] please!

nodes.text: The girls reluctantly get up off the couch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, both of you, into your rooms! I've got some eggs to hide!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sure, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Whatever you say...
$ZOE herds the girls into their room...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No peeking!
Several minutes later, $ZOE opens the door to the girls' room, and they trudge out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! Get excited! You're never going to find the eggs I hid!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There's one. It's resting on the TV.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: There's another by the wastebasket.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Here's one right by the couch.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: There's one on the beanbag chair, one in the fireplace, and one on the ping pong table...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How?! How are you this good?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're Easter pros...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: There's another in your hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was behind my back!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: In that plant over there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, well, that's `almost` all of them. You'll `never` guess where I hid the last...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, well, that's [color=#3b78e2][i]almost[/i][/color] all of them. You'll [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] guess where I hid the last...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Refrigerator.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: In the egg carton.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! We're not even `in the kitchen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! We're not even [color=#3b78e2][i]in the kitchen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks for trying, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No offense, but Howard's a lot better at hiding them...
Kay flops back onto the couch. Kel yawns before flopping down next to her sister.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! I've never seen them like this! Time to call in some backup!
Twenty minutes later, $ZOE introduces Sam and Amanda to Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, this is Kay, and this is Kel.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Kids.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What'd you bring us?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Did you bring us any candy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, but if you want to keep the candy you have, you won't annoy me, got it?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: She makes all my hair stand on its end!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, and this is Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Kay!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hi! You're pretty!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks! And hi to you too, Kay's clone!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Uh, I'm Kel.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! She talks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aaaanyway, thanks for coming over here on such short notice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was thinking for entertainment we could bake together, or play a board game, or...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We want an Easter Egg Hunt!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Easter Egg Hunt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Easter Egg Hunt `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Easter Egg Hunt [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We already `did` an Easter Egg Hunt... Or have you somehow forgotten that you're both egg-hunting wizards?
nodes.text_bbcode: We already [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] an Easter Egg Hunt... Or have you somehow forgotten that you're both egg-hunting wizards?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We haven't forgotten, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We just thought that you and your friends should get a chance to find some eggs too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want `us` to look for eggs that `you` hide?
nodes.text_bbcode: You want [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] to look for eggs that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] hide?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, we'll show you how a `real` Easter Egg Hunt is supposed to go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we'll show you how a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] Easter Egg Hunt is supposed to go!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What do you say? Come on, pleeeeease!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When they beg like that, are you supposed to feed them or walk them or something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're not dogs, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I think that's a great idea, girls! We'll go into a room, and you can set up the Easter Egg Hunt for us...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I didn't bring my egg-hunting spear!
Sam pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought Howard's sisters were supposed to be little hurricanes in girl form... Won't it be a bad idea to take our eyes off them?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not today. They've been kind of sad about Howard leaving... And when they're sad, they actually seem... Docile.
$ZOE, Sam, and Amanda go into one of the bedrooms...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No peeking!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Keep your eyes `closed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Keep your eyes [color=#3b78e2][i]closed![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Later, Kay and Kel let them out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were in there for a long time, Kay.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, well, um, we had to hide the eggs extra good.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And that we did!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee hee! Prepare to be found, eggs! We're sending you back to the rabbit that laid you!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I like her.
As $ZOE, Sam, and Amanda wander around the room looking for eggs, the twins keep giggling...
After a few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I only found one!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a baseball, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I only found zero!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, girls. Funny joke. Now where are the eggs?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We can't tell you!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That would spoil all the fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You won't be having any fun at all if you don't tell us where the eggs are `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You won't be having any fun at all if you don't tell us where the eggs are [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are we even in the right room?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Speak!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We didn't hide any of them `in` the house...
nodes.text_bbcode: We didn't hide any of them [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] the house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You left the house!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course... It's not really a hunt if you do it indoors!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Outdoor Egg Hunt?! I'm going to go get my egg-tracking galoshes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, that's not necessary, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, not when they're going to show us where all the eggs are hidden!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Awww... No fun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! No fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it's not that big of a deal... It might actually be fun to try finding eggs in the front yard...
$ZOE sees the mischievous looks on the twins' faces...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We didn't hide any of them just outside the house either...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is there a cage we can put them both in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You girls weren't even supposed to leave the house without my permission! Now you're telling me you hid them who knows where!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't worry! We'll show you where...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Field trip! Whoop!
A few minutes later, the girls are standing in front of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The `police station?!` You hid the eggs in the `police station?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]police station?![/i][/color] You hid the eggs in the [color=#3b78e2][i]police station?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `One` of the eggs, actually.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]One[/i][/color] of the eggs, actually.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: In a locker.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Right inside a bag of 'evidence'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess one egg's not the end of the world... We can probably just leave it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... What now?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We figured you wouldn't be all that motivated to go after `just` an egg ... So we hid something else in there too!
nodes.text_bbcode: We figured you wouldn't be all that motivated to go after [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] an egg ... So we hid something else in there too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sam's purse!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! I'm going to...
$ZOE holds Sam back!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! Sam! No!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Egg `and` Purse Hunt?! Ohmygosh! I'm going to go get my purse-net!
nodes.text_bbcode: Egg [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Purse Hunt?! Ohmygosh! I'm going to go get my purse-net!

nodes.text: $ZOE turns to the twins...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you did this! When your parents find out you went to a police station, I'm going to be in `so` much trouble!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you did this! When your parents find out you went to a police station, I'm going to be in [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much trouble!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't you know the first thing about getting in trouble?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It doesn't happen if you don't get caught!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't deal with either of you now! We've got to get Sam's purse back. Come on...
Ten minutes later...
An alarm sounds, and the girls sprint out of the station with $ZOE holding the evidence bag!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who thought it was a good idea to pull the fire alarm?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was red and shiny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind that! Which one of you threw a smoke bomb?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Amateurs! This way!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hide!
$ZOE, Sam, and Amanda hide next to Kay and Kel in a thicket of bushes just in the nick of time!
Officer Monte bursts out of the police station, plumes of thick smoke filling the air around him...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know you're out there! I know you can hear me! When I get you, I'll rip your ears off like a chocolate bunny!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Like a delicious... Chocolate-y... Easter bunny...
Monte seems lost in thought as he stumbles back to the police station...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotta get some more officers in this hoodlum-infested town.
As soon as Monte's gone, the girls run off!
A few minutes later, $ZOE pulls Sam's purse, along with the hidden egg, out of the evidence bag!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay! Congratulations, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That was really fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, this bag has your names on it!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Turns out, Officer Monte has a big case against us!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I didn't even know what ballistics were until today!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait wait wait! This was all some trick to get us to steal evidence Monte had against you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why wouldn't you just take the bag of evidence when you hid the egg?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Duh, then it's not fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It wasn't `fun!` You girls are in big trouble! We're going home `right` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]fun![/i][/color] You girls are in big trouble! We're going home [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then she's gonna call your parents and tell them you've been horrible children!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, ease up! Don't worry, girls! I'm not going to call your parents about this... I'd get in just as much trouble as you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just be glad this is finally over with...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Don't tell me...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: A phone call will be difficult...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please don't say that.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It wouldn't be an Easter Egg Hunt with just `one` egg!
nodes.text_bbcode: It wouldn't be an Easter Egg Hunt with just [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] egg!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we might have hid your phone with the second egg for insurance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think Sam was right. Maybe we `should` have put you in a cage!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm beginning to think Sam was right. Maybe we [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] have put you in a cage!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're sorry, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, we're sorry...
$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not sorry because when you're sorry, you don't smile, you actually feel sad. Just tell me where the egg is so I can get my phone.
Just then, a parade rounds the corner...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eep! Pretty! Pretty! Pretty!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Speak of the egg!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We did!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: The egg's in that float in the middle!
Kay points to a float with a large paper-mache egg on it, surrounded by dancing people in rabbit outfits.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll go get my egg-hunting camouflage suit!
Amanda runs off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How are we going to get my phone from a moving float?! As soon as we try to climb onto it, the parade will stop!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess we'll just have to follow it until the parade ends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That could take all day...
A few minutes later, Amanda comes bounding up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How do I look?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Amanda! That's brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I've never heard anyone say that before! I `love` Easter!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've never heard anyone say that before! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] Easter!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Amanda, if you go up onto that float, you can get my phone back!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But why would I want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry... I meant, you can get the egg!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And while you're there, you can get my phone!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay again!
A minute later, Amanda returns, holding $ZOE's phone, the egg, and a tuft of fur from one of the costumed rabbits...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Those rabbits are feisty! But I showed them who's boss!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Okay, now I like her too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are those the only two eggs that you hid, girls?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Maybe...
Sam grabs each of the twins by the ear...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Don't twist! Don't twist!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Answer!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There's one more! It's at Chip's house!
As the sun sets, all five of them arrive at the Chapman house...
Chip answers the door.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa! So many girls!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hey, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I was just napping, er, working out...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What are you all doing here?
Sam nudges the twins...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where's the egg?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So pushy...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We need you to take off your shirt, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, girls, we just want to know where the egg is...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we're telling you where it is... Even though this totally ruins the purpose of the hunt!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Take it off, Chip.
Confused, Chip takes off his shirt and exposes a tattoo of an egg on his chest!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What?! When did `that` get there?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! When did [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] get there?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hahaha! While you were 'working out'!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hee hee hee! Don't you know, Chip, you should never nap on Easter!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Easter isn't a day for pranking!
The twins fall over with laughter!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That does it!
$ZOE pulls both of the twins aside...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's not permanent, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, it comes right off... In three to six weeks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you two have a knack for getting into trouble, but this whole day has been one big mess because of the two of you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I took pity on you because I thought you were sad about your brother going off to college...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's why I `tried` to give you an Easter Egg Hunt in the first place!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why I [color=#3b78e2][i]tried[/i][/color] to give you an Easter Egg Hunt in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how did you respond to my kindness? By breaching all of my trust!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're... We're really sorry, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah... We didn't mean to make you angry...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We didn't even know that you could `get` angry!
nodes.text_bbcode: We didn't even know that you could [color=#3b78e2][i]get[/i][/color] angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, `this` 'I'm sorry' seems to be a lot more real than the first one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] 'I'm sorry' seems to be a lot more real than the first one.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We were just trying to do what you did for us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You seemed really sad about Howard, so we thought we'd give you something that would distract you all day!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey, Twins, did you just say something about Howard? Is something wrong with him?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Nothing's wrong with him...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He's just going away to college...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're going to miss him... We all are...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I know how that feels. My brother Spike's been in college for forever. When I found out he was going, I thought I'd never see him, and that he'd, like, stop being my brother.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And did he?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Nope. Not at all!
Chip cracks the door open a little more, and Spike calls to him from the living room...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yo, Chip, get back in here so we can beat the last level, man! This is the final boss!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sometimes I think it's better 'cause he appreciates me more than he ever did when he was in high school!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks, Chip! That makes me feel a lot better!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!
Kay and Kel give Chip a giant hug. He blushes!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You're welcome!
That night $ZOE puts the twins to bed and says good night to Sam and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure thing. But the next time you want my help with the Hurricane Twins... Don't ask.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not surprised.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But you can ask `me` double! I love Kay and Kay's clone!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you can ask [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] double! I love Kay and Kay's clone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Again, not surprised... Bye, guys.
As $ZOE settles in for a night alone on the couch, the doorbell rings. She opens the door...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! What are you doing here?! I thought you weren't coming back until tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We saw everything we needed to see over at Kingston... And I didn't like the idea of spending Easter without those closest to me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, your sisters really missed you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I missed them too, but they aren't who I was referring to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... I missed you too.
Howard takes $ZOE's hands...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know this whole 'me going to college' thing is going to be rough on us...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm scared...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I just want you to know right now that I love you, that I'll always love you, and that you're the one I want to be with when I feel alone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... I feel the same way about you, Howard!
Howard holds her close, kissing her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy Easter, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... Now it is!
And a Happy Easter to you too!
Here's wishing you a good one and all the luck finding those elusive eggs!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You girls seem to have it all... Really cute uniforms, awesome hair, and... I heard you guys throw the wildest parties...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hee hee... You have no idea.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Do tell.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You might have what it takes to be one of us. But one more question... What `special skill` can you bring to the team?
nodes.text_bbcode: You might have what it takes to be one of us. But one more question... What [color=#3b78e2][i]special skill[/i][/color] can you bring to the team?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'm a professional...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Guess I can't brag about all those years profiling criminals for the FBI...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're a professional what?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Mind-reader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh... Tell me more...
And for the next twenty minutes, Natara profiles the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: $ZOE, your vast reserves of compassion are both your vulnerability and your strength.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Be nice to people, but don't let others take advantage of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's so profound!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Jill, you feel invisible because no one hears your voice. And no one hears you because you feel invisible. It's a vicious cycle.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That makes so much sense...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And Jessica... You feel the need to control the world around you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what you see about me? What do you know anyway?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You manipulate people not because you're excessively mean, but because you can't control your home life.
A tear starts to stream down Jessica's face.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're right!
Amanda raises her hand.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh me next! I want a horoscope reading!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda, she's not reading horoscopes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's reading, like... Your soul.
Amanda sidles up to Natara.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Amanda... I see a brilliant personality under the veneer of a happy but shallow facade.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You don't have to pretend you're not intelligent to impress people.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But that doesn't `sound` like the future...
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]sound[/i][/color] like the future...

nodes.text: Natara sighs.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You're also a Taurus.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gasp! You are so right!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow, guys, she's really good! Can we keep her?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes. We can. Cheerleading practice for new recruits starts next week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But there is something `special` we're doing on Saturday night. We're meeting at Prom to do it.
nodes.text_bbcode: But there is something [color=#3b78e2][i]special[/i][/color] we're doing on Saturday night. We're meeting at Prom to do it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you want in on it, you should come.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'll be there...
Mal neatly side-steps away from all the punches!
Off-balance from his clumsy throws, Ryan pitches forward! Mal pushes him into the wall.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa! You made that look cool!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I know.
Mal grabs Ryan, twists his arm behind his back, and smashes him down against a desk!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow! You're breaking my arm!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Trust me, kid, if I wanted to, it'd already be broken.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: But you have information I want. Do you know who's behind the bear thefts at the local zoo?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: No, I couldn't.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I didn't make the team.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: It really is like high school all over again.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That's disappointing...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Tell me about it...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I mean, I was `dying` to see you in a cheerleading uniform...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I was [color=#e23b3b][i]dying[/i][/color] to see you in a cheerleading uniform...

nodes.text: Natara playfully punches Mal's arm.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: But more to the point... I did manage to get something useful out of her.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Well...
Natara scans Mal's face and finds the bruise on his jaw!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And did you get into a fight?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'd call it more of a scuffle, really.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: This one bully got in a lucky shot.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Mal, you can't beat up a high school boy!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Don't worry. There's not a scratch on him.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Well, does he have anything to do with the smuggling ring?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: No. He lacks a certain finesse.
Mal tries to dodge, but Ryan throws a punch that connects with his jaw!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mal staggers back, touching his cheek.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That was just embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, there's more where that came from!
Ryan takes another swing at Mal!
Mal dodges this time, catching Ryan's fist!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: One hit is lucky. Two is just sloppy.
Mal twists Ryan's arm behind his back and smashes him down against a desk!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Now, you have some information I want. Do you know who's behind the bear thefts at the local zoo?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Why do I want to be a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Uh... It would look good on my college application?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: College?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And, you know, all the best politicians were cheerleaders back in their heyday.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is that a day for horses?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, why are you even bringing up politics?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We hate that...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Which is ironic because girls know the most about it...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She's making my brain hurt with her smart words...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I don't think we need to go on. You're just not cheerleading material.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We don't have any room for someone like you.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Hey, I have important ideas... My value is hardly based on your social opinion.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, my social opinion is that we don't let losers on the squad.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Bye-bye.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Bye-bye.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Natara walks away from the field, eyeing her surroundings.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: New plan...
When Natara is certain the cheerleaders aren't paying attention, she slips behind the bleachers...
Creeping slowly, she gets underneath the pack of girls, eavesdropping on their conversation as they gossip.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This is kind of boring... Can't we just pick someone already?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're here for the long haul.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, you could always start thinking about what you're wearing to `the special event` on Saturday night.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you could always start thinking about what you're wearing to [color=#3b78e2][i]the special event[/i][/color] on Saturday night.

nodes.text: Natara leans closer.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What else would I wear? Duh. Black. I don't want to get caught.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Good point.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, do you know what time we're meeting?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sometime in the middle of `Prom.` We're going to sneak out. So bring a stash of clothes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometime in the middle of [color=#3b78e2][i]Prom.[/i][/color] We're going to sneak out. So bring a stash of clothes.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Prom, huh?
Natara slips away.
Meanwhile, in the detention hall, Mal walks in...
And finds a group of three nerds!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...So then he triggered the space bomb in hyperspace, making it a hyper bomb!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That doesn't conforms to physics by any stretch of mathematical calculation.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's just a show, Dex.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're just a show!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What are you eggheads doing in here?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hal! Welcome to detention!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Detention sure has changed a lot since I was in school.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's part of the rehabilitation program. Instead of staring at the wall during detention, you have to study with us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And we'll be your professional tutors!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I liked it better when we passed dirty notes and set things on fire...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We're going to ask you some questions.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Actually... I have some questions for you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that works out for everyone! A question for a question! Just like a hostage situation.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Sure, kid. Me first.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: There's been some funny business going on down by the zoo. Bears are getting smuggled out.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Do you guys know anything about that?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No. Now it's our turn for a question. Which famous explorer sailed from Europe to America in 1492?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Pffft. Easy. That's Christopher Columbus.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: One for one!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Back to me. Are you sure you don't know anything about the bears?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Absolutely positive. I'm allergic to dangerous animals including bears, lizards, and kittens.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, so which European explorer...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Cut your questions. I have a different agenda here. Do you guys know anything about who might steal bears?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooh! I know! Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Anyone else?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Hal. I honestly don't know who'd steal a bear. We've all had run-ins with them before in the woods, and they're really scary.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe some of the rebels, but even then...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Where can I find the rebels?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There's one behind you.
Ryan stands in the doorway of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nerds! There you are.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What do you want, Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I have homework. You have time.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But we did all your homework last week...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And now I need you to do it again. Unless you want to talk to the fists...
Ryan growls at the nerds menacingly. Erik stands up and tries to throw his shirt!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What do they `teach` you in this school?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do they [color=#e23b3b][i]teach[/i][/color] you in this school?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! It's throw `dirt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! It's throw [color=#e23b3b][i]dirt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That's right.
Ryan punches Erik in the gut!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not my other spleen!
Erik crumples.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You dweebs are really going to just let this joker abuse you like that?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What else are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, you want a piece of me, new guy?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I can take you. Even if you're, like, fifty years old.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going to rip you a new one, kid.
Mal stands up, and Ryan starts punching!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, girls, bring it in!
Jessica walks down the line, looking each girl over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You with the short neck... You're out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You with the pimple face... Get out of here!
Jessica stops in front of Natara.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you! I don't know what's worse... Your hair, your moves, or that horrible suit! I mean, it doesn't show any skin at all!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get out of here! You make me sick!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Hey, just wait a minute...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We only take the best, and clearly you're not cheerleading material.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I've heard that before...
Natara walks away from the field, eyeing her surroundings.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, girls, bring it in!
Jessica walks down the line of girls, looking each one over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You with the short neck, you're out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You with the pimple face... Get out of here!
Jessica comes up to Natara.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're in... And surprisingly limber for someone wearing a suit. Interviews are next.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Now I'm getting somewhere...
She and the cheerleaders settle on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, you're Natalie, right?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Yeah, that's right.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What makes you want to be a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: If I'm going to get in with these girls, it's important to cite reasons they're sure to like...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Go Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Go Blizzards!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Go, uh... Uh... Llamas?
Nicole jumps up and yells 'Go Lizards!'
Natara jumps up and yells...
Natara attempts a sideways flip and lands on her butt!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Ugh...
She scrambles to her feet.
Natara cartwheels!
Natara stares uncertainly at Nicole, missing the beat entirely...
Nicole does a cartwheel!
Natara jumps left!
Natara jumps right...
And bumps right into another girl!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ow! Watch yourself! Don't blow this for me!
Natara freezes, not sure what to do, as all the other cheerleaders jump left!
After class, Natara strides out of the room angrily.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I thought the plan was to blend in!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So there was a hiccup in the plan.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It's nothing I haven't dealt with before.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'm `sure.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: We're still doing what we're supposed to be doing.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: The plan was to find information. And that's exactly what's happening.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Please explain to me what hanging around in an empty detention room is going to achieve.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Clearly you didn't get in trouble enough in high school...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And yet I'm somehow utterly unsurprised that you did...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Yes, but that's not the point.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: The `point` is, I'll be in detention... With the `detention kids.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]point[/i][/color] is, I'll be in detention... With the [color=#e23b3b][i]detention kids.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: See where I'm going with this?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I suppose students in detention often have higher rates of delinquency than normal students.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Which might lead me directly to the smuggling ring.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Perhaps your rebellious tendencies will help our case after all.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You'd better believe it.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Anyway, while you're questioning the delinquents, where do I look?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I talked to that girl Jessica... It sounds like the popular girls are going on a special mission sometime soon...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: And it sounds suspicious. Jessica even specifically mentioned a `zoo.` We're going to have to figure out what this mission is and where they're going to meet up.
nodes.text_bbcode: And it sounds suspicious. Jessica even specifically mentioned a [color=#e23b3b][i]zoo.[/i][/color] We're going to have to figure out what this mission is and where they're going to meet up.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And how am I supposed to get in with them?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: This is the best part. You ready?
Mal points to a poster on the wall that reads, 'Want to be popular? Come to cheerleading try-outs! Report to Jessica this afternoon!'

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You can't be serious.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: As a heart attack.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Isn't there any other way?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Do you think there's another way? What's the quickest way into the popular girls' clique?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: A common identity. Which means...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh yeah. You're going to be a cheerleader!
That afternoon, Natara arrives at cheerleading practice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay girls! There are two rounds of try-outs... Cheers and interviews.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you do well on the cheers, then you'll move on to the interviews.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But if you suck at cheers... Then you're out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's get started! Follow what Nicole is doing!
Music starts playing, and Nicole steps in front of the group of girls trying out. Natara steps into line and prepares to cheer...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Okay... Hopefully this won't be too hard...
Nicole jumps to the left!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I was just confused, uh, about the assignment.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Jessica here was trying to explain it to me, but I'm pretty sure she hasn't actually read anything herself...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Traitor!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And you were in no way asking Jessica out for the weekend?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: `Hal!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hal![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Uh-huh. May I remind you that this is a history class, not a dating service.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And you'll have plenty of time to think about that in `detention.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And you'll have plenty of time to think about that in [color=#3b78e2][i]detention.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I mean, who wants to learn about a bunch of stiffs from the 1500s?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Unless they're taking a party boat to the New World, I'm out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what `I'm` talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! That's what [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] talking about!

nodes.text: Several other students in the class chuckle.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Guess I'm not the only one who thinks so.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I hope you don't think you're funny.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I know I am?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, you'll have plenty of time to think about it in `detention.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you'll have plenty of time to think about it in [color=#3b78e2][i]detention.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mal looks over at Natara who is shaking her head.
It is another beautiful day at Centerscore High, and class is just about to start.
A nondescript civilian car pulls into the school's lot and edges another student out of a parking spot.
`Detective Mal Fallon` and `Special Agent Natara Williams` from the San Francisco Police Department step out of the car and survey the area.
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Detective Mal Fallon[/b] and [b]Special Agent Natara Williams[/b] from the San Francisco Police Department step out of the car and survey the area.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So run our new case by me again... We're going undercover as students at the very high school my niece used to go...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: That's right...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: To bust some teenagers...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'm with you...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Who are stealing bears from the Centerscore Zoo...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: A zoo which is, it should be noted, at least five counties out of our jurisdiction.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: That is correct.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You don't see anything strange about this scenario?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I mean, honestly, who steals bears?!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'll admit this is an unusual case.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: But no matter how ridiculous it is, the orders came from the top. Captain Yeong specifically asked us to work this one.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: But we're Homicide. Last I checked, it was a bear `smuggling` case, not a bear `mauling` case.
nodes.text_bbcode: But we're Homicide. Last I checked, it was a bear [color=#e23b3b][i]smuggling[/i][/color] case, not a bear [color=#e23b3b][i]mauling[/i][/color] case.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Which, now that I think about it, would be Animal Control's job anyway...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Look, I don't necessarily understand it either. But after the incident at the Mayor's Ball...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: How could I have known that he needed that cane to walk?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: You `promised` Captain Yeong you'd follow all orders to the letter.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]promised[/i][/color] Captain Yeong you'd follow all orders to the letter.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: All right, all right. What's our plan?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: We socialize with the students until we get a sense of which social group might be behind the theft.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You really think these kids know anything?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Do you have any better leads?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Well, we could...

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Leads that `don't` involve punching teenagers?
nodes.text_bbcode: Leads that [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] involve punching teenagers?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: ...Your plan it is.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Now let's go. Class is starting.
During first period...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Class, I'd like to introduce two new transfer students...
Ms. Prez looks to them.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: And your names were...?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Mal Fallon.
Natara nudges Mal.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I mean, Hal Talon.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: And I'm Natalie Williamson. Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Does anyone have something they'd like to ask the new students?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why are you dressed like you're going to a funeral?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And why do you look so old?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's probably all that stubble.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Whoa, hold up. Don't insult the stubble.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think it's classy! It makes him look mysteeeeeerious!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Now here's a kid who knows something.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been trying to grow a beard like that since I was five.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Don't get your hopes up.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All right, I think that's enough. Hal, Natalie, please take a seat in the back.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, we were talking about the Age of Exploration yesterday. Please partner up with the person next to you and review the content.
Natara turns to the guy next to her.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: So... Tell me about the Age of Exploration...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If you want to meet up after school... I can show you a whole new `age` of `exploration` if you know what I mean...
nodes.text_bbcode: If you want to meet up after school... I can show you a whole new [color=#e23b3b][i]age[/i][/color] of [color=#e23b3b][i]exploration[/i][/color] if you know what I mean...

nodes.text: Natara shudders.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Thanks for the offer, but I prefer guys who smell like they shower more than once a week.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm conserving water...
Meanwhile, Mal is paired with Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So... Are we going to do this or what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, no way.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I haven't read anything since the fifth grade. My boyfriend just summarizes things for me.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That sounds about right. Reminds me a lot of my ex-wife...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I mean... `Ex-girlfriend...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ex-girlfriend...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pffft. Whatever. You look like the kind of guy who's used to girls fawning over him...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: And you look like the kind of girl who knows everything and everyone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah? What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What do you and your friends do for fun around here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Talk about Prom? It's on Saturday, you know.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Anything else?
Jessica glances around, then turns back at Mal, a serious look on her face.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there is something else, something the cheerleading squad and I have been planning on doing for weeks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's going to be awesome. I can `barely` wait. And it'll really show everyone at that `zoo`.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's going to be awesome. I can [color=#3b78e2][i]barely[/i][/color] wait. And it'll really show everyone at that [color=#3b78e2][i]zoo[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What exactly are we talking about here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a `secret` mission, but it'll be super fun. We've done it before...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a [color=#3b78e2][i]secret[/i][/color] mission, but it'll be super fun. We've done it before...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: When is this going down?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Last time I checked, between the 14th and 15th century.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ms. Prez!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Ms. Blaire, Mr. Talon, what is going on here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was trying to focus on the lesson, Ms. Prez, I swear. But he was distracting me!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Way to throw me under the bus...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, Hal, what do you have to say?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
`Just kidding!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Just kidding![/b]

nodes.text: Not only are we bringing you an episode... We're bringing you three crazy mini episodes!
Hold on tight... Because things are about to get `weird!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold on tight... Because things are about to get [b]weird![/b]

nodes.text: In Dex's laboratory...
The nerds stand in a circle around a glowing orb.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's so glowy...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And so orby!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think it's gorgeous...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, but does it work?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It should. Dex and I made the adjustments.
Dex flips a switch just under the orb.
The colors of the orb shift and swirl, as images start flitting across its curved surface.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You guys are geniuses!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Someone's clearly not modest.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We all have our flaws.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Some more than others.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Shh! The pictures are moving...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We really did it now, guys! We created a looking glass into different dimensions!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What will we see?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Worlds we could never imagine!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Bear thefts?! What? Who steals a bear?!
Mal evaluates Ryan's words and his terrified face.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: My question exactly.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You're crazy, man! I don't know nothing about bears! Let me go!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So maybe you're not the bear snatcher, but... You beat up these nerds.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: And you're going to stop.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? No way!
Mal twists his arm just a little bit more.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I recommend being nice to the little weirdos. One day, you'll be pumping their gas.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow! Okay! I got it! Just let go!
Mal shoves him away, and Ryan runs out the door.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks, Hal.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're one cool cufflink!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: A couple tips. First, that's not a phrase.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Second, if you're ever going to make it to the top of the social ladder, you have to start sticking up for yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Anyway, if detention's over... I'm out.
The nerds watch him walk away in awe and wonder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I want to be just like him when I grow up... The coolest cufflink in the world!
Later that afternoon, Natara and Mal meet up in front of the school.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: There you are! I just received a text from Captain Yeong asking about our progress.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: She sent a text?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Yeah. It reads... 'Status on the case?'

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: We'd better respond quick. There's a sadistic smiley face after it.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: So did you find anything on the delinquents?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What about you? Did you get anything out of Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: She told me that whatever's happening is going to happen the night of Prom.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Prom? I'm okay masquerading as a student for a day, but if you think I'm putting on a monkey suit...
At that moment, Mal's phone buzzes. A new text fills his display.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: `'You MUST go to Prom. The bear smuggling must be stopped.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'You MUST go to Prom. The bear smuggling must be stopped.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: News travels fast...

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'll say.
That Saturday night at Prom...
Mal and Natara enter the dance hall and observe the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Well, I spotted the cheerleaders. They're over by the balloons, taking pictures of themselves.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: They've been there for the last hour.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I've been on many stakeouts in my life. And this is quite possibly the worst.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Try to have a little fun. It's a dance after all.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It's not really my thing. What about you? Did you attend all the high school shindigs?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Yes, but I usually went to these events with friends.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: What, no high school sweetheart?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: No. Braces were a real downer on my love life.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You had braces?!

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Not so loud!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'm just surprised. No wonder you're so comfortable with steel.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Lighten up. It's a dance, after all.
Mal's phone vibrates.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Is it another text from Captain Yeong?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Yes. She's ordering us to blend in with the crowd.
Natara looks across the dance hall. A slow song has started, and all the couples are dancing to the music.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: When in Rome...
Natara and Mal step onto the dance floor and sway slightly.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: So this is what I've been missing all this time?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh, I wouldn't be surprised. Some soft lighting, a power ballad, and a half dozen pimple-faced high schoolers staring at you...
Mal's phone buzzes again.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Again? This just isn't like her. What does it say?

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It says 'Stand closer.'

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Is... Is she `watching` us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is... Is she [color=#3b78e2][i]watching[/i][/color] us?

nodes.text: Suddenly Mal notices the popular girls moving towards the exit of the dance hall.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: No time for that. They're on the move!
Natara and Mal surreptitiously follow the girls, obscuring themselves behind the dance hall building.
The cheerleaders go to a big van in the lot and fling the doors open!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is it, girls! Tonight we're pulling a prank on those Wilson cheerleaders that they'll never see coming!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I didn't see it coming either!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The plan is... We sneak over there and shrink all their uniforms!
Natara gasps.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like a sophisticated plan to steal a bear from the zoo. What is going on here?
Mal's phone buzzes again.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Another text?
Natara frowns as if puzzling something out. She grabs Mal's phone.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Let me see that.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: 'Forget the cheerleaders. Go back to the dance.'

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Is she watching us from somewhere? How does she seem to know what we're doing?
Natara scrolls through the messages, her brow furrowing deeper.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Mal, we've been tricked! This isn't Captain Yeong!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: How can you tell?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: When was the last time you remember Captain Yeong sending a text ordering us to do anything?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Also, do you think Captain Yeong would misspell her own name?!
She holds up the phone where the bottom of the text reads 'From the official desk of Maria Yong'.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: That does explain the emoticons...  But if it's not the captain, who is it?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: I'll give you one guess. Who's the one person who'd set up an elaborate case just to get us to dance at a high school Prom?
Natara punches a number into the phone.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Kai!
Somewhere far away, in the crime lab of the SFPD, Forensic Tech Kai Kalaba answers the phone with trepidation.

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: If it isn't my favorite FBI Agent and her grumpy sidekick... How can I help you today?
From her corner of the lab, Amy looks up at Kai with a desperate look on her face.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: Kai! It's no use pretending... Not only did they figure out that it was you, they found the camera!
Amy turns her computer screen to face Kai. On the screen, live footage displays Mal shaking his head at Kai.

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: Ah... So you figured it out... Well, to be fair...

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: Amy was in on it too!
Amy runs to the phone.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: He convinced me to do it! I... I... I'm sorry. I just couldn't help it.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: ...Hello?
Amy frowns and lowers the phone.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: They hung up.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: I can't believe I let you talk me into this!

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: It was worth it! Come on, getting Mal and Natara to pretend they were in high school and dance together at Prom? Priceless. It's their own fault they didn't figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: But now Natara is mad at me!

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: If there's one thing I've learned, people will forget why they're mad at you the moment you do something worse.

nodes.speaker: Amy
nodes.text: No way.

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: Don't be upset, Amy.
Kai glances at the computer screen and grins at what he finds.

nodes.speaker: Kai
nodes.text: Look at what we've accomplished!
Amy looks at the feed of the camera they had monitoring Mal and Natara.
Mal and Natara are back on the dance floor. They take the last slow dance of the night...
Then dismantle the camera, leaving high school for good.
Back in Dex's laboratory...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa, that was a weird one!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know! Imagine that! Real detectives in our school!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Want to watch another one?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I wonder what happens when we try to look in a universe that's `really` far away!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wonder what happens when we try to look in a universe that's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] far away!

It's the day of the Spring Festival, and the race is just about to begin!
$PONY warms up in a field next to the real track, thinking about her friends' advice from yesterday.
Monkey, lizard, bear... Monkey, lizard, bear...
Clyde comes up to her.
I hear it's a toss-up between you and Snappaloosa for the Spring Festival Championship this year.
Who do you think it'll be?
Make your choice!
It's definitely going to be me.|I'll do my best.
What do you neigh?
You don't believe you'll win?
It's not that. It's just that I've seen other horses get overconfident when it comes to racing.
So I've just decided that whatever the outcome of today...
As long as I put in everything I have, it'll be a good race.
I'm not used to your way of thinking, but I like your attitude.
Score Up!
Yay!
Good luck out here. I'll be hawing for you.
Thanks! I'm dedicating this race to you.
Pony up, $PONY.
You're so confident about it.
Is there something wrong with that?
No, I like it. It's just... It must be hard to have such high expectations for yourself.
What happens if you make a mistake?
You think I'm going to make a mistake?
No! Maybe I'm just suggesting that you loosen up a little.
Oh... Yeah. I'll do that.
Pony up, $PONY.
$ZOE, please tell me you're not having problems with `your` boyfriend.
Actually...
Colt and I kind of... Totally had a fight yesterday.
I was hoping I could talk to you about it, if you don't mind.
Well, it is true that ever since I became the Queen of Hearts, I've been helping everyone!
So can you give me some advice?
Colt and I love spending time together, but sometimes I just think our interests are too different.
He `is` the baddest boy in school, and you are the nicest girl. Sometimes it's weird to think that you ever started dating him.
Opposites attract?
What do you do when you are together?
He always wants to go on a motorcycle ride. But I don't like being a passenger. It's really hard to hang on!
What do you want to do?
I just want to do what I love best: baking. But every time I invite him over to make cupcakes, he says 'no'!
Does he like cupcakes?
I don't even know!
$ZOE sobs into her books.
Calm down. Why don't you try...
Make your choice!
Getting your own motorcycle?|Asking him to bake cookies instead?
Why don't you try...
Maybe the problem is that you're just asking him to make the wrong thing.
You think he's more cookie than cupcake?
I don't know if I'd put it that way...
But you do have a point. If he keeps rejecting all my baking invitations...
It must be what I'm making!
He did say he wanted to do new things... Baking `cookies` sounds perfect!
Thanks, Sam!
What?
You said it yourself... You don't like being a passenger, so why don't you drive your own instead?
But... But I don't know how to ride a motorcycle...
That's the brilliant part, $ZOE. He can teach you. And guys love teaching their girlfriends new things...
I guess I could try it...
Thanks, Sam!
Sam approaches her locker and realizes that it's blocked by Jessica and Ryan arguing.
Ryan, I've told you a million times... You're never going to get elected President if you don't make more friends on Faceplace!
I'd rather suck face with you at my place.
Ugh, grow up!
All right, all right. `Your` place.
...How about `behind the bleachers?`
Whatever you say, babe. See you soon!
`Ahem.` Do you mind?
Jessica looks over at Sam, as if seeing her for the first time, and smiles.
Sam... Girl emergency. Now.
Jessica pushes Sam into the girls' bathroom.
Boy problems?
How'd you know?
Seems to be something in the air...
It's Ryan! I want to change him. I want to make him better, so that he becomes President, so I can be First Lady again!
That's... Weird, but understandable. So?
I wish he were more Presidential, but everyone thinks he's a sleazeball.
He `is` a sleazeball.
But no one has to actually `know` that!
So what do you want?
You're good at being utterly repulsive but still likeable.
Thanks.
What do you think I could do to make him win?
From what I know about politicians, photo ops can really make or break them.
Photo ops?
Yeah, pictures of them with the right people. You should get Ryan to take a picture with...
Make your choice!
Three hots girls.|A kitten.
You should get Ryan to take a picture with...
Ew! Why would he do that?
You know, some politicians try to make themselves look nicer and more family-oriented by kissing babies on the campaign trail...
You want Ryan to kiss a kitten?! Ew!
No! But maybe if Ryan poses with something cute like a kitten, he'll look better.
Don't you think it'll make him look really lame?
Come on, can Ryan do anything to his reputation to make it worse?
I guess playing with a cute kitten isn't a terrible idea for his image... I'll try it.
All I need is a kitten! But where do I find one?
And make him look like more of a shady womanizer than he already is?
You said everyone thinks he's a sleaze. Turn that image around.
Pose the shot so it looks like the girls are actually having fun.
Make it look like the girls want to be with Ryan because he's a party to be around!
Then when he tries to hit on girls from now on, it'll just seem like he's the party type.
Hmmm... That's actually not a terrible idea...
I'm here all day.
Well, I'm not. See you, Sam... I need to find three hot cheerleaders to put Ryan with.
Jessica strides out of the bathroom, leaving Sam alone.
I hope I can still make it to class... I've had enough of this for one day...
A Different Twin Branches
Couple Swap
One fine day, Sam and $ZOE walk through school...
And see several couples arguing!
Nicole... Don't be mad at me, babe! Come on!
For the last time, Keith, you are not allowed to borrow my hair gel without my permission!
But it's super strong... And it smells like you...
I can't tell if that's gross or sweet...
Elsewhere down the hall...
You can't blame me for short-circuiting your hard drive!
Mathematically speaking, it can be no one else... But you.
There must be some mistake, Robot Girlfriend...
There is no mistake. You disconnected one of my wires. Do not think I forgot that you did not get me a gift for our 1.010 month anniversary...
Awww, man...
What is in the water today? Is every couple fighting?
After school, Sam hears a loud commotion in the Auto Shop...
She enters, calling out.
Hello?
Sam rounds a corner and finds Erik tangled up in a mess of hoses and belts.
Erik!
Sam rushes over and helps him out.
What happened?
Turns out role-playing is not romantic!
At least not for me!
When I took the loot from our latest raid, she tangled my one-armed giant up faster than you can say 'one-armed giant'!
And then she did the same thing in real life...
I'm sorry she didn't like the game...
Wait, what? No, Megan `loves` it!
She tied me up here to teach me a lesson for losing all our party's equipment!
And then she went back to her character to schmooze up a one-legged marauder who owns his own firewagon shop!
Can you believe it?
It's pretty hard to believe...
Erik dusts himself off.
I guess not all games are easy...
And love is the hardest of all.
He trudges out of the Auto Shop, his shoulders slumped.
Awww...
Sam rounds a corner and finds Erik and Megan making out!
Oh wow. That's going to be burned into my eyeballs for way too long...
Hey, if you want to keep your eyes, you'll go and run somewhere else, `Sam.`
It's okay, Megan. She's the one who helped me earlier!
Sam, we found that spark! And we didn't even need spark plugs!
Score Up!
Awesome...
Turns out that romantic episode of Space 'Splosions was the best thing we could've done!
Space 'Splosions just speaks to the perfect mashup between nerd and vehicle engineer!
Glad to hear it.
I'm going to let you two get back to it...
Come here, my lug wrench...
Anything you say! Whew boy! I'm going to need a windshield wiper at the speed we're going!
Ewww...
Sam runs outside where she finds a Presidential rally.
Ryan is on top of a platform, campaigning for himself.
Vote for Ryan! I'm the best!
And hey, look! Ryan's holding a kitten!
From nowhere, Jessica produces a kitten for Ryan to hold.
Uh, no... I'm allergic...
Just take it!
Why?
It's good for your Presidency!
Ryan takes the kitten...
Meow... Meow...
The kitten starts wiggling in Ryan's arms.
Oh crap! Don't do that, kitten! Uh...
Ryan holds it close trying not to drop it, but the kitten fur tickles Ryan's nose!
Oh no... Ah... Ah... `Achoo!`
Ryan sneezes and loses his grip on the kitten! Jessica lunges forward and catches it before it falls!
Sorry, kitty...
Though the kitten is safe, a roar of outrage goes through the crowd!
Look what he did to the kitten! He threw it!
I can't vote for him... He's a kitten thrower!
Kitten thrower!
Kitten thrower!
Over the crowd, Jessica shoots Sam a poisonous glare.
That didn't win me any favors...
Around him, girls clamor for his attention.
Ryan reaches down to shake their hands.
